step-started.rule: Resume the same governed step without duplicating the start record.

step-finished.rule: Do not replay a completed governed request; continue from its resulting state.

handoff-recorded.rule: Only the recorded target agent and capability may continue with the current handoff.

human-approval-recorded.rule: Preserve the recorded human approval and continue only from the approved state.

authority_invariants: Persistence and recovery do not create or widen assessment eligibility.
Persistence and recovery do not create scored-delivery authority.
Persistence and recovery do not create production assessment API eligibility.
Persistence and recovery do not create institutional, high-stakes, certification, licensure, assessment-release, or broad production-release authority.
Human approval remains separately recorded evidence and is never synthesized during recovery.
